title: A finite type quasi-coherent module on an affine scheme is generated by finitely many global sections
statement: Let $U$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Then there are finitely many global sections $h_1,\dots,h_k\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal G)$ which generate $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], i.e. the map $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus k}\to\mathcal G$, $(f_1,\dots,f_k)\mapsto\sum_jf_jh_j$, is surjective as a map of sheaves. In fact any finite family of elements generating the $\mathcal O_U(U)$-module $\Gamma(U,\mathcal G)$ (which is finitely generated) does.

source.place: Properties, Lemma 01PB (label lemma-finite-type-module) together with Schemes, Lemma 01IA (label schemes-lemma-quasi-coherent-affine: a quasi-coherent module on Spec R is the sheaf associated to its global sections); EGA I (1.3.13), cited in EGA II proof of 4.5.5
